title: Star Wars Origins: The Dam Busters - Side by Side Scene Comparison
summary: A three-minute side-by-side comparison of scenes from Star Wars (1977) and the WWII film The Dam Busters (1955). It shows how closely the Death Star trench run mirrors the earlier film.
why: HN links it whenever the topic of Star Wars borrowing from WWII films comes up, as direct visual evidence.

quote.text: the following youtube [1] shows how much the original Star Wars borrowed from old WW2 movies
